prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ONLY_FT_rf', seasonality_champion='FT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: ONLY_FT_rf achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while FT_rf leads in seasonality capture (0.885), but rf delivers the lowest overall RMSE (548.92) by balancing both components. The extreme RMSE spread ratio (12.78) and concept drift indicate significant model disagreement, making STL-hierarchical stacking ideal to exploit decomposition-aware combination while handling drift. Early/late horizon specialists differ (catboost vs ONLY_CWT_rf), further supporting decomposition-based methods over simple averaging.
